coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX, with two advisories. Fifteen attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject d97adad4 at 0444, 4633 bytes, unmoved and unedited; v2 remains 7cb52916 as the dispatch requires and equals the subject's own predecessor pin; HEAD never left 5d5d778; required-now 26 of 26. Four of four cited digests reproduce, including the parent pin 175723e3. The decisive test passes: the parent's harnesses array holds exactly one DR-G05 entry and it is deep-equal to the subject's harness object by full recursive comparison — no key on either side the other lacks, no shared key differing, including the nested threshold and pairedWorkload objects, the four deltaFormula terms and the five-entry failsIf. claimVerbatim and owner were checked against file 08's live row rather than only against the parent and both are exact, and the live threshold cell — 'measurement mandatory, caps deferred by explicit disposition' — agrees with the harness's 'NO numeric cap in D-006'. The numeric-cap prohibition is the one this gate is most exposed to, since its own threshold cell defers caps rather than setting them, so I refuted it by enumeration rather than by reading the disclaimers: every bare integer in the whole artifact is 0, 3, 5 or 21 — the sign bound, the version, the D-006 clause number and the D-102 sample size — with no fifth integer for a cap to hide in. The artifact also states the absence three times and carries the invention as a failsIf entry. The analyze prohibition is refuted twice over, in pairedWorkload.command and in failsIf, and both occurrences of the word are refusals. I verified the predecessor claim rather than accepting it, since v2 is a file the dispatch tells me not to review: v2's harness object is equal to v3's and v2's parent pin is 11a305c6, which is precisely what predecessorV2 says — a modest and true claim that does not overstate what v3 changes. Worth noting beyond the dispatch: the specification closes the obvious way this gate could pass vacuously, by forbidding G03/G04 help/version/doctor-read-only as the subtracted baseline, requiring identical endpoints on both sides of each pair, and failing a negative delta on the stated ground that the component cost was hidden in the core. Two advisories, both shared with the DR-G03 sibling extraction I accepted earlier and both family properties rather than defects introduced here: the extraction pins no HEAD, file 08 digest or required-now figure and carries no reviewStatus or sealRecommendation, which v1 and v2 also lack, leaving the file unable to date itself; and the parent's own bytes still say AWAITING-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW while the verdict this subject correctly pins records ACCEPT 0/0. A single coordinator disposition would cover both extractions. This ACCEPT is of the extraction's fidelity and prohibition compliance, not a fresh acceptance of the parent's content.
